test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If A × B means that A is the brother of B, A ÷ B means that A is the sister of B, A + B means that A is the father of B then which of the following expression shows that P is the sister of R?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44b1d977930a5ae8ff2ad87e3b6407517b08dce70e8f045c243365162391bc53.png] 

Given: 

 
 

 **A is**
 
 

 **Symbol**
 ×
 ÷
 +
 
 

 **Meaning**
 Brother
 Sister
 Father
 
 

 **of B**
 
 

 

Drawing a family tree by given symbols we get,

1) P + Q × R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd7dea3fd6744005d3035f65593bd3cbb36ea31325b5b8a445cdc6b7c5abe1ff.png] 

Here, P is the father of R.

2) **P ÷ Q × R**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e9cb514937f1e0537859f75778dea27b906b1d3d7f15590b3ebf2331f6aeaf6.png] 

Here, P is the sister of R.

3) P × Q ÷ R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c3afe5b1d5a33813f04406bb918c01bc36d69d18a3045b61ff1f81fa64bc85c.png] 

Here, P is the Brother of R.

4) P ÷ Q + R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86d892eaf3a94caa9825ee54ce5a070852e7864acbf8b5f6abd080875da0096e.png] 

Here, P is the Paternal Aunt of R.

So**, Option 2 **gives **'P is the sister of R'.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**
